result.instructions: Tools for Burq, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much would a 2 kg parcel cost to deliver from our store to 10 Main Street today?"; "Can Burq deliver from our warehouse to this address in Toronto?"; "Show me the status of order 1234 and where the driver is.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Burq data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run burq_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run burq_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run burq_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. burq_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: burq_get_estimates
tools.title: Get delivery fee estimates
tools.description: Estimate the delivery fee between two ZIP codes for item dimensions, without creating an order. Returns the 10th, 50th and 90th percentile fee in cents, from historical deliveries. Burq API: POST /v2/estimates.

weight_unit.description: Weight unit: lb, kg or g.

estimates.description: One or more origin and destination pairs.

tools.name: burq_check_serviceability
tools.title: Check serviceability
tools.description: Check whether Burq can deliver from a pickup address to a drop-off address. Creates nothing. Returns serviceable: false (still a success) when Burq cannot deliver between the two. Burq API: POST /v2/serviceability.

address.description: Full pickup address as one line.

store_id.description: Burq store id, instead of an address.

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code.

latitude.description: Latitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

longitude.description: Longitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

window.description: Optional pickup or drop-off time window (ISO 8601).

address.description: Full drop-off address as one line.

store_id.description: Burq store id, instead of an address.

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code.

latitude.description: Latitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

longitude.description: Longitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

window.description: Optional pickup or drop-off time window (ISO 8601).

tools.name: burq_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get the latest state of one order: pickup and drop-off, items, tip, route ids and delivery status. Burq API: GET /v2/orders/{id}.

expand.description: Optional comma-separated fields to expand, as the vendor documents them.

tools.name: burq_list_routes
tools.title: List routes
tools.description: List delivery routes (multi-stop groups of orders), newest first, with cursor paging. Burq API: GET /v2/routes.

starting_after.description: Return the page after this route id (next page).

ending_before.description: Return the page before this route id (previous page).

tools.name: burq_get_route
tools.title: Get a route
tools.description: Get one route with its orders and stop sequence. Burq API: GET /v2/routes/{route_id}.

tools.name: burq_list_route_quotes
tools.title: List route quotes
tools.description: List the quotes for a route from the latest quote generation. While quoting is in progress, status is PENDING and data is null. Burq API: GET /v2/routes/{route_id}/quotes.

tools.name: burq_get_route_quote
tools.title: Get a route quote
tools.description: Get one route quote: cost of delivery, Burq fee, provider, courier and pickup time. Burq API: GET /v2/quotes/{id}.

tools.name: burq_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create one delivery order (pickup, drop-off, items). This records an order and books no courier; dispatch is a separate call. Burq API: POST /v2/orders.

unit_price.description: Unit price (integer; the vendor states no unit).

weight_unit.description: Weight unit: lb, kg or g.

store_id.description: Burq store id, instead of an address.

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code.

latitude.description: Latitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

longitude.description: Longitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

window.description: Optional pickup or drop-off time window (ISO 8601).

store_id.description: Burq store id, instead of an address.

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code.

latitude.description: Latitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

longitude.description: Longitude as a string. Burq requires coordinates.

window.description: Optional pickup or drop-off time window (ISO 8601).

order_value.description: Total value of all items (integer; the vendor states no unit).

tip.description: Driver tip (integer). Burq forwards all tips to the provider.

contains_alcohol.description: Set true when items contain alcohol.

external_route_ref.description: Your own route reference, for multi-stop grouping.

external_stop_seq.description: Stop position within your route (1 = first).

tools.name: burq_create_route
tools.title: Create a route
tools.description: Group existing orders into one route so it can get quotes and be dispatched. Burq API: POST /v2/routes.

order_ids.description: Order ids to include (can be empty).

tools.name: burq_generate_route_quotes
tools.title: Generate route quotes
tools.description: Start quoting a route with delivery providers. Runs asynchronously; read the result with burq_list_route_quotes. Books no courier. Burq API: POST /v2/routes/{route_id}/quotes.

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle internal name, for example car, suv or truck.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (a random UUID). Send the SAME key on the first call and on every retry within one hour; a repeat returns the first result.

tools.name: burq_dispatch_route
tools.title: Dispatch a route
tools.description: Dispatch a route from a chosen route quote. In production this books a real courier and charges the account. Sandbox creates no real delivery. Send one idempotency_key with the first call and reuse it on any retry, so a lost response cannot book a second courier. Burq API: POST /v2/routes/{route_id}/quotes/{route_quote_id}/dispatch.

checkout_additional_service.description: Extra helpers or assembly for every order on the route (not supported for all routes).

type.description: Service type. Equipment is not supported yet.

value.description: Value or values for this service.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (a random UUID). Send the SAME key on the first call and on every retry within one hour; a repeat returns the first result.

tools.name: burq_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancel the latest delivery of an order. Fails when the driver is already en route. Burq API: POST /v2/orders/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: burq_cancel_route
tools.title: Cancel a route
tools.description: Cancel a route. Runs asynchronously; the outcome arrives by webhook. Burq API: POST /v2/routes/{route_id}/cancel.
